item.title: Steps taken to control coconut rhinoceros beetle
item.description: The state Department of Agriculture and Biosecurity will move forward with starting an interim rule-making process to combat the coconut rhinoceros beetle on the Big Island.

item.title: Inside Aaron Glenn’s and the Jets’ week of coaching-staff turmoil
item.description: It was one year ago, exactly. Aaron Glenn stood in front of a crowd of reporters, Jets staffers and former Jets players at his introductory press conference as the franchise’s new head coach and announced to the world that things were going to be different with him in charge.

item.title: Letters — Your Voice — for January 29
item.description: ‘Heritage of our night sky is worth preserving’

item.title: Tom Brady on Bill Belichick’s Hall of Fame snub: ‘Completely ridiculous’
item.description: Tom Brady labeled Bill Belichick’s snub from the Pro Football Hall of Fame as “completely ridiculous” on Wednesday.

item.title: Five teams to watch at NBA trade deadline: Could Bucks upgrade with Giannis out?
item.description: Players aren’t the only ones on the trade block. Teams are, too.

item.title: US, Denmark start talks over Greenland deal to assuage Trump
item.description: U.S., Danish and Greenlandic officials met Wednesday to discuss a new framework deal over Greenland, an attempt to satisfy President Donald Trump’s desire to see a greater American presence on the Arctic island that stops short of ceding it to the U.S.

item.title: FBI agents search election center in Fulton County over 2020 vote
item.description: WASHINGTON — FBI agents executed a search warrant Wednesday for an election center in Fulton County, Georgia, seeking to seize ballots in a significant escalation of the administration’s efforts to investigate a jurisdiction that President Donald Trump has continued to criticize over his 2020 defeat in the state.

item.title: US handing over seized tanker to Venezuela, officials say
item.description: The United States is handing over to Venezuela a tanker that it seized this month, two U.S. officials told Reuters on Wednesday.

item.title: US expects to finish review of Epstein files soon, Bondi says
item.description: The Justice Department now expects to finish its review and public release of government files related to Jeffrey Epstein “in the near term,” Attorney General Pam Bondi said in court filings Tuesday in New York City.
